notes:
The popup says what Enter is about to send, every time it is not the plain prompt. Builds on [v0.2.19](https://github.com/bekalpaslan/promptline/releases/tag/v0.2.19).

### What Enter sends

- **Every hole is said before you press Enter.** The Enter hint turns amber and reads **paste without clipboard** when the clipboard is empty, **paste with 1 field empty** in a fill-in form, and **paste, wraps last prompt** when the clipboard still holds the prompt pasted last. The action panel's Paste and Copy say the same. A pinned prompt that wraps the clipboard now hollows its icon on an empty clipboard too; the pin used to hide it.
- **Enter in a fill-in form goes to the next empty field** and sends only when none is left ahead; the hint reads **next field** until then. Every field's Enter used to send, so Enter after the first value pasted the prompt with the rest missing. Ctrl+Enter still copies at once, and Enter from the last field still sends with fields left blank on purpose.
- **A failed paste is not sent again by accident.** While "Couldn't paste into that window" is up, the first Enter, slot key, click or panel action only clears the message; the hint bar reads **Ctrl V in the target**. The clipboard line shows that it now holds the prompt.
- **"Really delete?" answered with Enter deletes.** Arming Delete by its digit left the highlight on Paste, so Enter pasted the prompt instead. Arming now takes the highlight and the focus, and the hint bar reads **delete** and **cancel**.
- **Undo after a delete has no clock** and survives closing and reopening the popup once. It used to expire after eight seconds.
- **Copying says what was copied**: `Copied "Explain this error" to clipboard`. Enter pressed while that message is up no longer pastes.

### Preview card

- **The card is always the selected row's.** Typing while it is open closes it; it used to stay on its old row while Enter pasted the new top result.
- **It can be read from the keyboard.** PgUp and PgDn scroll it, it opens at the clipboard's place in the prompt, and Copy sits under the text, always in view.
- **A card opened by hovering changes nothing else.** The hint bar keeps describing the selected row, and the card sits under its row instead of over it.

### List

- **A row found by its text shows where it matched**, underlined, in place of the prompt's opening words. Under a `#tag` filter the row's tag is the one asked for.
- **Eight prompts where seven fit.** Rows sit closer, a group's prompts are no longer indented, and Ctrl is printed on the first slot only.
- **One inset.** The search box, the clipboard line, pack names, rows and the hint bar share their edges, and everything in them starts on one line. The scrollbar no longer pushes the rows' right edge in when the list scrolls.
- **Folding never moves the selection to another section.** A click on a pack's name used to carry the selection there and change what Enter pasted. While anything is folded the list says so and names **Ctrl →**, which unfolds everything. Folds are still remembered between summons.
- **At 125% UI scale the hint bar drops hints instead of wrapping**, and at the smallest window size Save prompt and a failed paste's message stay in view.

### Manager

- **Buttons show a solid focus ring** when reached by keyboard; it was faint enough to miss.
